auth.shib.title: Shibboleth / SAML
auth.shib.help: Single sign-on with SAML 2.0 identity providers. Native mode: give the identity provider the metadata URL below. Header mode: run Apache with mod_shib in front of the wiki, protect /api/v1/auth/sso/shib/start and add Apache to server.trusted_proxies.
auth.shib.name: Button label
auth.shib.idp_metadata: IdP metadata (XML, alternative to the URL)
auth.shib.single_logout: Also sign out at the IdP (single logout)
auth.shib.single_logout_help: Sends a signed LogoutRequest to the IdP if it has a single logout endpoint.
